'''Mcnamara''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the [[Corellia Metropolitan]] reported from [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that heavy Imperial losses in the fight against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had led ex-Senator Mcnamara to call for a full troop withdrawal from the conflict to protect the lives of the Empire's soldiers from "terrorist attacks".

==Behind the scenes==
The senator is mentioned in a short news report on a [[Newsnet terminal]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It does not specify whether he was a member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] or the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].
